#### <i class="bi bi-info-circle"></i> About the series

**The dataset:** 500 fictional participants from a simulated bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) study, with participant metadata and cell counts for each study visit. The raw files are deliberately messy, like real study data. No row describes a real person.

[<i class="bi bi-download"></i> bal_metadata.xlsx](tutorials/data/bal_metadata.xlsx){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}
[<i class="bi bi-download"></i> bal_cell_counts.xlsx](tutorials/data/bal_cell_counts.xlsx){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}
[<i class="bi bi-download"></i> bal_baseline.csv](tutorials/data/bal_baseline.csv){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}

**You'll need:** R and RStudio for every tutorial, plus Python from Tutorial 2 onwards. Work through them in order: each one builds on the last.
:::
